Bug_Details: Scope annotations used as qualifier annotations don't have any effect. Move the scope annotation to the binding location or delete it.
Bug_Explanation: The @Singleton and @Inject annotations are misplaced and will not have any effect. The @Singleton annotation is placed on a field instead of a class or method that defines a binding. Similarly, @Inject is used without a proper dependency injection framework to resolve dependencies.

Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by creating an instance of MisplacedScopeAnnotationsExample using its constructor, which relies on the incorrectly placed @Singleton annotation on the 'dependency' field. This misuse of the @Singleton annotation does not affect the test outcome directly but indicates a potential issue in the production code.
